observations.title: JamLib role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: Shares platform abstractions, JSON5 configuration and supporting utilities for JamCore mods; a consuming mod owns harvesting or other player actions.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified; do not change installed configuration from these research notes.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. Public URL identifies the upstream project, not a claim that a missing web guide was read. Multiple packaged versions remain loader-resolution candidates: 1.3.6+1.20.1-patch.1
